RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 30

Raising the panel’s gender without concrete evidence carries severe professional risk and will likely damage your reputation. An all-female panel hiring a qualified candidate is not legal or logical proof of bias. For a group head role, commercial acumen, interview performance, and client development often outweigh pure technical tenure, and eight years plus chartered status is a substantial qualification. 

While unconscious bias or diversity considerations cannot be ruled out, alleging discrimination based solely on demographics is unsubstantiated. Instead, follow up politely on your pending feedback request. Frame your inquiry constructively around understanding the specific leadership and client-facing competencies they prioritized so you can strengthen future applications.
